faqs.question: How do I know this battery fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the ThinkPad X240, T440 and T450 series (internal battery). Note these models use two batteries — internal and external — this listing is for the internal one. The part number on your old battery is the safest way to confirm. If you're unsure, send us a photo of the sticker on your battery on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.
